name: Sitelets – Multisite Local Website Manager
author: @SaaSy

sections.description:
Sitelets provides a centralized system for managing large networks of location‑based websites within WordPress Multisite.

Sitelets is designed as a centralized platform for managing distributed website networks. While delivered as a WordPress plugin, it is built for organizations that require control, consistency, and scalability across multiple locations.

Organizations operating franchises, dealer networks, healthcare groups, real estate brokerages, or distributed service teams often struggle to maintain consistent branding and messaging across many local websites. Sitelets solves this problem by combining centralized publishing with controlled local editing.

Administrators can define global design standards, content structures, and brand rules while still allowing local site managers to update approved sections of their individual sites.

Instead of manually managing dozens or hundreds of subsites, Sitelets allows network administrators to deploy, update, and manage local websites efficiently from a single control interface.

Sitelets is designed for organizations that require both scalability and strict brand governance.

Key Capabilities

• Centralized management of WordPress Multisite location websites
• Brand framework enforcement across all subsites
• Controlled editing permissions for local site administrators
• Scalable deployment of new location websites
• Network‑wide publishing and update capabilities

Free Version Features

• Centralized Sitelet management inside WordPress Multisite
• Creation and administration of multiple subsites from a single dashboard
• Brand framework controls for consistent design across sites
• Local administrator roles for location owners or managers
• Compatible with WordPress Multisite environments
• Foundation architecture for scalable location‑based website networks

Professional and Enterprise Features

Sitelets offers Professional and Enterprise licensing for organizations managing multi-location website networks at scale.

• Unlimited pages, posts, admins, and users across Sitelets
• Instant Sitelet cloning to launch new locations quickly
• One‑click publishing from the main site to all Sitelets
• Network‑wide content updates with centralized control
• Advanced page and block‑level editing permissions
• Granular brand locking for styles, layouts, and elements
• Global‑to‑local media asset management
• Automated deployment workflows for new Sitelets
• Priority support and ongoing updates
• Enterprise plans include advanced network control, automation, and onboarding support.

Professional and Enterprise licensing available.
Learn more at: https://sitelets.com

Ideal Use Cases

• Franchise networks
• Healthcare provider networks
• Real estate brokerage and agent sites
• Dealer and distributor networks
• Multi‑location service businesses
• Enterprise organizations managing regional websites
• Sitelets is commonly used by franchise systems, healthcare groups, and enterprise organizations managing dozens or hundreds of location-based websites.

External Services

This plugin connects to the Sitelets service (sitelets.com) for two purposes:

  1. Notifications: the plugin dashboard retrieves product notifications and
    announcements from https://sitelets.com/wp-json/sender/v1/notifications.
    No personal data is sent with this request.

  2. Feedback and bug reports: when a user chooses to submit the feedback form,
    the submitted report is sent to
    https://sitelets.com/wp-json/sitelet-feedback-api/v1/submit along with the
    submitter’s email address, username, user role, site domain, browser
    user-agent, and the list of installed plugins, to help diagnose issues.
    Nothing is transmitted unless the user submits the form.

Terms of Service: https://www.sitelets.com/terms-of-service/
Privacy Policy: https://www.sitelets.com/privacy-policy/
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/sitelets directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Ensure WordPress Multisite is enabled.
  4. Configure Sitelets from the Network Admin dashboard.
sections.faq:
Does Sitelets require WordPress Multisite?

Yes. Sitelets is built specifically for WordPress Multisite environments.

Can local site owners edit their content?

Yes. Network administrators can define exactly what sections local administrators are allowed to modify.

Is Sitelets compatible with page builders?

Yes. Sitelets works alongside common WordPress themes and page builders including Elementor.

Can I manage many location websites?

Yes. Sitelets is designed for organizations managing anything from a few sites to hundreds of location websites.

How does licensing work for larger organizations?

Sitelets offers Professional and Enterprise licensing based on the size and complexity of your website network. Visit https://sitelets.com to learn more or request a demo.
